verdict.rationale: Unity's player command-line docs document a headless mode in which the built application displays nothing and accepts no user input, so game logic can run without rendering. Unity also documents multiplayer packages and services, and build profiles for platform-specific build configurations. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of a dedicated-server build target or server-runtime build profile, documentation of server-specific stripping of rendering and assets, and independent or hands-on corroboration of running headless server builds in production.
